content.title:
The Dominican Republic is a special place in the Caribbean because of its history, culture, and natural beauty. It shares the island of Hispaniola with Haiti, making it the only Caribbean nation with a land border. 

The country has a rich cultural mix influenced by Taíno, African, and Spanish roots, which is reflected in its food, festivals, and daily life. Its landscapes are very diverse, featuring white-sand beaches, lush rainforests, dry deserts, and Pico Duarte, the highest mountain in the Caribbean. 

The Dominican Republic is also known as the birthplace of merengue and bachata, music styles that represent the energy and spirit of its people and are enjoyed around the world.
